    cin >> n;

    cin >> s;
    int length = 0;
    int max_len = 0;

                length = 0;
                break;
            case '(':

                length = 0;
                inParen = true;
                break;
            case ')':
                if (length > 0) count++;
                length = 0;
                inParen = false;
                break;
            default:
                length++;
                break;
        }
    }
    if (length > 0) max_len = max(max_len, length);

    cout << max_len << " " << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
